title: Parse Port
summary: Parse a TCP port number from input. Surrounding whitespace is allowed; the rest must be ASCII digits only, and the value must be in 1-65535. Anything else is an error.
hints: Trim, then reject the input unless it is non-empty and every character is a digit. Most built-in number parsers accept '+' or '-', so check the characters yourself.
A string of digits can still overflow a native integer. Check the length, or parse into something wide enough before range-checking.
Return an error with a helpful message: 'not a number' and 'out of range' are different problems.
